1: const MAX_DELAY_MS = 300_000;
2: 
3: const DECIMAL_SECONDS_RE = /^[0-9]+$/;
4: const NUMBER_RE = /^[+-]?(\d+\.?\d*|\.\d+)([eE][+-]?\d+)?$/;
5: const HEX_RE = /^[+-]?0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+$/;
6: 
7: export function parseRetryAfter(value, nowMs) {
8:   if (typeof value !== 'string') return null;
9:   const trimmed = value.trim();
10:   if (!trimmed) return null;
11:   if (DECIMAL_SECONDS_RE.test(trimmed)) return Number(trimmed) * 1000;
12:   if (NUMBER_RE.test(trimmed) || HEX_RE.test(trimmed)) return null;
13:   if (!Number.isFinite(nowMs)) return null;
14:   const dateMs = Date.parse(trimmed);
15:   if (!Number.isFinite(dateMs)) return null;
16:   return Math.max(0, dateMs - nowMs);
17: }
18: 
19: export function computeRetryDelay({ attempt, retryAfter, nowMs }) {
20:   if (!Number.isInteger(attempt) || attempt < 1) throw new Error('attempt must be a positive integer');
21:   if (!Number.isFinite(nowMs)) throw new Error('nowMs must be finite');
22:   const retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfter(retryAfter, nowMs);
23:   if (retryAfterMs !== null) return Math.min(MAX_DELAY_MS, retryAfterMs);
24:   return Math.min(MAX_DELAY_MS, 1000 * 2 ** (attempt - 1));
25: }

(End of file - total 25 lines)
